# runzero_wireless_lan (Data Source)

Fetches a single RunZero wireless LAN by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the wireless LAN.

### Read-Only

- `agent_name` (String) The agent name.
- `authentication` (String) The authentication method.
- `bssid` (String) The BSSID (MAC address) of the access point.
- `channels` (String) The channels used by the wireless LAN.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp (Unix epoch).
- `encryption` (String) The encryption type.
- `essid` (String) The ESSID (network name) of the wireless LAN.
- `family` (String) The device family.
- `interface` (String) The network interface.
- `last_agent_id` (String) The ID of the last agent that observed this network.
- `last_seen` (Number) Last seen timestamp (Unix epoch).
- `last_task_id` (String) The ID of the last task that observed this network.
- `org_name` (String) The organization name.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID.
- `signal` (Number) The signal strength (0-100).
- `site_id` (String) The site ID.
- `site_name` (String) The site name.
- `type` (String) The type of the wireless network.
- `vendor` (String) The vendor of the access point.
